verdict.rationale: Otter's pricing page lists a first-party Zapier integration. Its integrations pages document pushing summaries, action items and transcripts into work tools such as ClickUp, Airtable, Jira/Asana and Google Drive, so notes do flow into work tools. However, nothing in the pack documents a Slack integration that posts notes to channels or a Notion integration that writes notes to pages, and the Zapier evidence is a single pricing-line mention. Missing for 10: documented Slack channel delivery, documented Notion page sync, detail on Zapier triggers and actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, notes flow into the tools where work happens — Slack channels, Notion pages, and thousands of apps via Zapier

citations.quote: Send meeting summaries and action items from Otter to ClickUp to manage everything in one place.
